tasks.label: Start local server
tasks.command: if curl -fsS http://localhost:8000/ >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Serving HTTP on existing server'; else exec python3 -m http.server 8000; fi

tasks.label: Start Chrome for debugging
tasks.command: pkill -f -- '--user-data-dir=/tmp/kfnd-chrome-debug-profile-headless' 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -f -- '--user-data-dir=/tmp/kfnd-chrome-debug-profile' 2>/dev/null || true; exec "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" --remote-debugging-address=127.0.0.1 --remote-debugging-port=9222 --user-data-dir=/tmp/kfnd-chrome-debug-profile --no-first-run --no-default-browser-check --new-window http://localhost:8000/index.html
